notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Forest.
description:
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl's first ability by paying {G}, causing the Forest to become a 1/1 creature until end of turn.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the Forest.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest land from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
